imageViewing: Original PNG pixels inspected; no conclusions derived solely from filenames. Other supplied route and vehicle JPEGs were also read before corresponding implementation.

camera.targetMeaning: point 10 m along actual optical axis

lighting.selectionAnchor: Main viewing camera, including fixed and paused views

practicals.policy: Main camera ground coverage, 20% selection hysteresis, one occupied-slot crossfade at a time, 2/3/4 bounded shadowed fixtures. Static bounced diffuse stays continuous between direct-light pools.

nightField.algorithm: Fixture cone quadrature → first static envelope hit → cosine diffuse virtual source → visible probe; nonnegative six-axis ambient-cube storage
nightField.source: One diffuse surface event, 24 deterministic cone samples per fixture, finite 22 m virtual-source influence, six-axis ambient-cube angular approximation and closed static envelopes. No direct light, daylight, emission-only signs or car headlamps are baked.

nightDirectField.algorithm: Stationary fixture intensity/range/cone → static visibility → six-axis direct diffuse irradiance; separate from retained one-bounce transport
nightDirectField.source: One diffuse surface event, 24 deterministic cone samples per fixture, finite 22 m virtual-source influence, six-axis ambient-cube angular approximation and closed static envelopes. No direct light, daylight, emission-only signs or car headlamps are baked.
nightDirectField.transport: Static direct diffuse with complementary live blend

blend.scope: Static city diffuse; car/headlights remain dynamic; real spot specular is retained.
blend.limits: Far shadows use the 4/8 m static envelope field. The transition blends two lighting approximations; moving-car shadows are retained in the near live region, not in the far baked region.
